headline.text: L1 Sollich 3 enrober lost control communication at 03:13 — *still down at window close* with buffer tank heating failures

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 enrober went down at 03:13 on control panel communication loss and has not returned; buffer tanks 3 and 4 cannot reach temperature by 06:27. Sollich 2 saw recurring hot caramel issues requiring multiple drum cleanings through the night. Sollich 4 ran clean.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 demolding belt tracked off at 05:08 after earlier tension and cleaning stops overnight — still down at window close. FFS had a 1 hour 51 minute film jam cleared by 03:11. Panning sorter conveyor fuse replaced in 56 minutes.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 cleared two sets of clogged nozzles (40 minutes at 07:23, quicker at 12:44) and replaced 80 dirty molds after chocolate buildup under hopper at 10:30. ML4 shower nozzles failed allergen test twice during changeover — blocking restart. MF Matrix changeover from Assorted to EBQ took longer than planned; sensor and gripper issues at startup resolved by 07:14.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 temper dropped to -0.5
resolved.summary: Tempering dropped out of range briefly during second shift production
resolved.resolution: Back in range at 18:35 — "We are back in the white at -0.3" (S3 Enrober)

resolved.title: FFS film tear and gusset punch jam
resolved.summary: Film tore at gusset punch at 01:20; maintenance cleared jam, cleaned blade, then found missing gusset requiring punch realignment
resolved.resolution: Running at 03:11 — "Line is back up. At 2:59a cause was jammed film inside gusset punch. Then realignment of punches" (Zack Kurtz)

resolved.title: Roof leak into ML wash area from clogged condensate line
resolved.summary: RTU condensate pipe clogged with debris caused drain pan overflow and water leaking into mold wash area; heavy wash held until resolved
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 14:08 — "Condensate pipe was clogged with debris... I removed all debris and check all the traps for L2 RTUs. No more issues with leaks" (William Lopez)

resolved.title: ML2 demolding belt bent and replaced
resolved.summary: Demolding belt bent too much during second shift; maintenance replaced belt and ATP test passed
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced and ATP passed at 16:49 — "The replaced belt passed the ATP test" (Marlenis Fernandez)

resolved.title: Panning sorter conveyor down on bad fuse
resolved.summary: Sorter conveyor stopped; maintenance was working FFS first then came to replace fuse
resolved.resolution: Fuse replaced at 02:58 — "Fuse was bad, replaced. Conveyor is running again" (Gustavo Rodas)

resolved.title: ML1 two clogged nozzles at startup
resolved.summary: Line down 40 minutes to clear two clogged nozzles; both hoppers emptied during the fix
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:07 — "The two clogged nozzles on ML1 have been cleared" (Grey Boscan)

resolved.title: ML1 chocolate buildup under hopper triggering camera faults
resolved.summary: Chocolate buildup on chain and pins under hopper caused dirty molds and repeated camera faults; 80 molds replaced
resolved.resolution: Area cleaned and 80 molds swapped out by 10:30 per Grey Boscan; covers confirmed in place by 10:23

resolved.title: ML1 second set of clogged nozzles midday
resolved.summary: Different nozzles from morning clog; operators cleaning and line sent to lunch
resolved.resolution: Running at 13:32 — "The line is running" (Grey Boscan)

resolved.title: ML1 flow-wrap belt torn
resolved.summary: Cavanna belt tore and required replacement; ATP test needed before restart
resolved.resolution: ATP passed and line running per same message at 05:53 — "belt has been replaced waiting on QA to do the ATP test. Atp passed line is up and running"

resolved.title: MF Matrix bag sensor and gripper issues at startup
resolved.summary: After long changeover to EBQ, line started at 06:45 but sensor not reading bags and machine not gripping properly
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 07:14 — "Adjusted the upper infeed belt position and the upper suction cups needed an alignment" (Nathan Ruiz)

resolved.title: ML1 single clogged nozzle third shift
resolved.summary: One nozzle clogged during third shift production run

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 enrober control panel communication lost
needs_attention.summary: Enrober lost communication between control panel and screen at 03:13; power supply replaced but buffer tanks 3 and 4 cannot reach 42°F by 06:27, blocking return pump operation
needs_attention.status: Maintenance replaced power supply by 05:03 but buffer tanks still below temperature at 06:27; alarm blocking return pump as of window close

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 lack of bottom chocolate coverage
needs_attention.summary: Many pieces showing insufficient bottom chocolate coverage; adjustments made at 22:37 for buildup in bottomer but issue persisted through 23:10
needs_attention.status: Victor at 23:10 still seeing lack of bottom on many pieces after 5+ minutes from adjustment; passing to next shift for further work

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 recurring hot caramel requiring repeated drum cleaning
needs_attention.summary: Caramel coming hot and liquidy starting at 00:18; chiller fluid was low and added but issue recurred at 04:10 and 06:47 requiring multiple production stops to clean drums
needs_attention.status: Stopped again at 06:47 to clean stuck caramel from second combar; caramel still soft and sticking to rollers despite chiller fluid addition earlier

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 temper unit power supply removed for S3 repair
needs_attention.summary: AB4 temper unit power supply pulled from Sollich 1 to repair Sollich 3 enrober; reference pictures taken of wiring before removal
needs_attention.status: Component removed and used for S3 repair as of 05:39; no plan stated for replacement or SL1 operation without it

needs_attention.title: ML2 demolding belt tracking off repeatedly
needs_attention.summary: Belt skipped at 00:33, adjusted and cleaned at 01:07, then tracked completely off drive side at 05:08; recurring tension and tracking issues through the night
needs_attention.status: Line down at 05:08, belt tracked off to drive side; Fernando assigned to work issue at 05:06 with no resolution by window close

needs_attention.title: FFS chocolate piece chains found in product
needs_attention.summary: Operators finding chains of chocolate pieces stuck together coming from upstream; quality concern for bag fill
needs_attention.status: Reported at 04:44 as ongoing issue — "We keep finding chains of chocolate pieces" with photo; no corrective action or root cause identified

needs_attention.title: ML4 shower nozzles failed allergen test twice
needs_attention.summary: Environmental swab phase 1 shower nozzles did not pass allergen test on second attempt during changeover cleaning; blocking restart
needs_attention.status: Failed allergen test for second time at 20:01; Tyson added shower nozzles to whiteboard for environmental swabs at 20:44 but no passing result shown

needs_attention.title: ML1 slip hazard from scrap barrel lid placement
needs_attention.summary: Scrap barrel lid placed on floor at base of ladders during active collection, obstructing walkway and creating trip hazard
needs_attention.status: Phillip identified hazard at 08:59 and requested designated storage spot for lid when barrel in use; no action or plan confirmed

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 4 capture test out of range
needs_attention.summary: Capture test too high on depositor 4; adjustments to lower rice caused defective bars, had to revert to original setting and looking for other solutions
needs_attention.status: Reverted to original settings at 16:38 after lower rice adjustment caused defects; team looking at other ways to bring ratios in range

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG3 coder fault
needs_attention.summary: TG3 coder showing fault; Spencer attempting to clean to restore function
needs_attention.status: Reported at 17:51; Spencer working to clean coder but no resolution confirmed

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG3 printer leaking ink
needs_attention.summary: TG3 printer has ink leak; maintenance looking at issue at start of first shift
needs_attention.status: Maintenance inspecting at 07:13; no update on cause or repair timeline
